generic_tasks.instruction: Implement a function to calculate candle body-to-range ratio and identify relative body size against a rolling window average.
Develop a volatility regime filter comparing current ATR against its own moving average.
Create a breakout detection module that monitors price breaches relative to a specific candle's high or low boundaries.
Implement a risk-based exit calculator that derives stop-loss and take-profit levels from a provided volatility metric.

integration_plan: 1. Initialize data stream with OHLCV and ATR inputs. 2. Apply UTIL-002 to gate signal generation based on volatility state. 3. Execute UTIL-001 to flag candidate candles. 4. Monitor price action via UTIL-003 for entry triggers. 5. Upon entry, instantiate exit orders using UTIL-004. 6. Enforce strict prohibition of non-linear position sizing or predictive modeling dependencies.
